parsed.why: No criminalisation, self-declaration recognition, referendum-backed marriage equality, functioning institutions and support networks; only cantonal detention/conversion gaps and rising denominator-free hate-crime reports temper an otherwise traveller-safe record.

Enforced sodomy statutes reach gender-nonconforming people: trans woman got eight years in a men's prison, upheld by the constitutional court in 2024; documented police arrests, assault, medical denial, forced stripping, and elite hostility.

Same-sex conduct legal, marriage equality, GI employment protections, bathroom access protected, and a trans murder prosecuted with a 12-year sentence; offset only by conservative social climate, high survey avoidance, and no GI hate-crime coverage.

Recent decriminalisation plus a gender-inclusive domestic-violence act and police training; residual negatives are individual dated incidents, an opposition vote at the UN, and no trans-specific data — thin but net traveller-positive.

Structural signals extrapolate badly: life-imprisonment statute, sustained police detention and humiliation targeting men dressed as women, refusal to classify LGBT killings, no non-discrimination recourse — dated but no record of relief.
